content: You found it the way everyone finds it: a vein of ore that should not exist, humming faintly when the pickaxe strikes.
This Codex records what you learn about NEXUS technology — and about the questions the technology refuses to answer.
Research is how you advance. Mine nexus ore, study kinetic machines, earn research points, and spend them on the research screen (R).
The central question stays open: what is the Nexus?
title: What Is the Nexus?
